topics.name: Heavy MG Rounds
topics.desc: Reloaded 12.7 mm cartridges from the depot stores.

topics.name: Reinforced Positions
topics.desc: Sandbags, sleepers and scrap plates around every emplacement.

topics.name: Engine Tuning
topics.desc: Carburettors cleaned, filters for the cold, winter diesel.

topics.name: Field Repair Kits
topics.desc: Every crew carries spare parts and a welder.

topics.name: Belt Feed
topics.desc: Reworked feed trays let the guns fire longer bursts. Unlocks the ZU-23 emplacement.

topics.name: Armour-Piercing Shells
topics.desc: Tungsten cores salvaged from the army warehouse.

topics.name: T-26 Restoration
topics.desc: The museum T-26 can be brought back to life. Unlocks the T-26 in the Tank Shop.

topics.name: Frost-Proof Concrete
topics.desc: Concrete that sets at minus thirty.

topics.name: Mortar Shells
topics.desc: A production line for 82 mm bombs. Unlocks the mortar pit.

topics.name: Composite Armour
topics.desc: Layers of steel, rubber and concrete bolted on the hull.

topics.name: Long Barrels
topics.desc: Longer barrels from the scrapyard: more range and punch.

topics.name: Optical Sights
topics.desc: Rangefinders taken from the abandoned plant.

topics.name: Reactive Armour
topics.desc: Explosive tiles that break incoming shells.

topics.name: Fire Control
topics.desc: A field computer for the mortars and artillery.

topics.name: FPV Drones
topics.desc: Racing quadcopters with a shaped charge. Unlocks the FPV drone in the Workshop.

topics.name: Guided Missiles
topics.desc: Konkurs launchers from the depot, wire-guided. Unlocks the UAZ Konkurs.

topics.name: Rocket Artillery
topics.desc: A Grad launcher and a crate of 122 mm rockets. Unlocks the BM-21 Grad in the Tank Shop.

topics.name: Missile Silo
topics.desc: An old tactical missile, a concrete pit and a lot of patience. Unlocks the Missile Silo.

topics.name: Air Defence
topics.desc: A Shilka from the regiment's park, radar and all. Unlocks the ZSU-23-4 Shilka.

topics.name: Rotary Guns
topics.desc: Six-barrel guns salvaged from a wrecked gunship. Unlocks the Rotary MG Tower and the BTR-80 Gatling.

topics.name: Infantry Fighting Vehicles
topics.desc: BMP-1s from the depot, patched up. Unlocks the BMP-1.

topics.name: Main Battle Tanks
topics.desc: A T-72B with a working engine and a stock of 125 mm rounds. Unlocks the T-72B.

topics.name: Heavy Artillery
topics.desc: 122 mm guns and their shells. Unlocks the 2S1 Gvozdika and the D-30 Howitzer.

topics.name: Thermobaric Rockets
topics.desc: A TOS-1 launcher and a few dozen fuel-air rockets. Unlocks the TOS-1 Buratino.

topics.name: Ballistic Missiles
topics.desc: A Tochka launcher with a working guidance unit. Unlocks the 9K79 Tochka.
